subject: Resending the attachment?
text:
Hi,

Thanks for the reply earlier. I was reviewing the service details you sent, and it looks like the attachment didn't come through on my side. Could you resend the pricing sheet or proposal when you have a moment?

We're trying to compare the plan with our current usage before making a decision, so having the missing document would really help. No rush, but if it's easier, a PDF link is also fine.

One quick thing: do the service levels in the attachment cover weekend support, or is that quoted separately? I want to make sure our team has the right expectations.

Also, if there is a separate onboarding timeline, I'd appreciate seeing that too. We are mapping out internal approvals this week, and it would make the handoff smoother.

If you need anything from us to generate a fresh version, just tell me what details would help and I can check with the team.

Appreciate the patience and your help so far.

Best,
